title: Cells and Cell Theory
seo_title: Grade 8 Science: Cells and Cell Theory Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Life processes are performed at the cellular level: the characteristics of life, the cell theory, the structure and function of cell parts, and microscopes. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 8, Biology)
meta_desc: Free Grade 8 science worksheets (BC): the cell theory, characteristics of life, parts of a cell, plant and animal cells, microscopes and specialized cells. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: All living things are made of cells.
key_sub: Cells come only from other cells.
body_html:
How to think about it

The cell theory says all living things are made of one or more cells, the cell is the basic unit of life, and all cells come from existing cells. Living things grow, reproduce, respond, use energy and get rid of wastes.

Animal and plant cells both have a cell membrane, cytoplasm, a nucleus and mitochondria. Plant cells also have a cell wall, a large vacuole and chloroplasts. Microscopes let us see cells; magnification = eyepiece × objective.

Example

Which cell part controls the cell's activities?

It holds DNA.

Answer: the nucleus

Example

An eyepiece is 10× and the objective is 40×. What is the total magnification?

Multiply them.

Answer: 400×

Common mistakes

  • Thinking animal cells have cell walls.
  • Adding the lens magnifications instead of multiplying.
  • Thinking viruses are cells.

items.q: By diffusion, which way does oxygen move here: from the blood or into muscle cells?

items.e: Particles diffuse from where there are a lot of them (high concentration) to where there are fewer (low concentration).
